# GET `/api/admin/dashboard`

## Description

Returns all data needed to render the admin dashboard in a single aggregated response. Includes platform-wide metrics, pending service center approval requests, and open/under-review reports.

## Authentication

Required — Bearer token  
Required role — `Admin`

---

## Request

No request body or query parameters.

---

## Response

### Fields

#### `metrics`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `totalUsers` | int | Total registered users on the platform |
| `bookingsThisMonth` | int | Total bookings created since the 1st of the current month |
| `activeCenters` | int | Total approved service centers |
| `avgServiceCenterRating` | double | Average rating across all approved service centers |
| `reportedReviews` | int | Total reports where target type is a review |
| `urgentReports` | int | Open reports with reason `Fake`, `Offensive`, or `Inappropriate` and status `Pending` or `UnderReview` |
| `pendingCenterRequests` | int | Total service centers awaiting approval |

#### `pendingApprovals`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `serviceCenterId` | Guid | Service center ID |
| `name` | string | Service center name |
| `ownerName` | string | Full name of the owner |
| `city` | string | City where the center is located |
| `submittedAt` | DateTime | When the center submitted for approval |

#### `recentReports`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `reportId` | Guid | Report ID |
| `reason` | string | `Spam`, `Inappropriate`, `Fake`, `Offensive`, or `Other` |
| `targetType` | string | `ServiceCenter`, `Review`, or `Issue` |
| `targetName` | string | Resolved name of the reported target |
| `reportedBy` | string | Full name of the user who submitted the report |
| `status` | string | `Pending` or `UnderReview` |
| `isUrgent` | bool | True if reason is `Fake`, `Offensive`, or `Inappropriate` and status is `Pending` or `UnderReview` |
| `createdAt` | DateTime | When the report was submitted |

### Example

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": null,
  "data": {
    "metrics": {
      "totalUsers": 12480,
      "bookingsThisMonth": 3241,
      "activeCenters": 184,
      "avgServiceCenterRating": 4.3,
      "reportedReviews": 27,
      "urgentReports": 5,
      "pendingCenterRequests": 12
    },
    "pendingApprovals": [
      {
        "serviceCenterId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
        "name": "Al Faris Auto",
        "ownerName": "Mohamed Hassan",
        "city": "Cairo",
        "submittedAt": "2026-03-12T00:00:00Z"
      }
    ],
    "recentReports": [
      {
        "reportId": "7bc12a34-1234-5678-abcd-2c963f66afa6",
        "reason": "Fake",
        "targetType": "Review",
        "targetName": "TopGear Workshop",
        "reportedBy": "Karim Adel",
        "status": "Pending",
        "isUrgent": true,
        "createdAt": "2026-03-16T14:00:00Z"
      }
    ]
  },
  "errors": null
}
```

---

## Notes

- `pendingApprovals` returns all pending centers ordered by `submittedAt` ascending (oldest first)
- `recentReports` returns only reports with status `Pending` or `UnderReview`, ordered by `createdAt` descending
- `targetName` is resolved server-side based on `targetType` — frontend receives the name directly
- Frontend is responsible for slicing list lengths for display (e.g. showing only the first 3)
- `bookingsThisMonth` resets on the 1st of each calendar month (UTC)
- `avgServiceCenterRating` is calculated across approved centers only
